answer: To resist sybils, anchor every agent to a single slashable stake: before an agent can take paid work, it locks a bond that is forfeited if the same device proof, payment account, or work history appears under another identity. A sybil operator trying to bloom a plume of thousands of fake agents must fund thousands of separate bonds, and one detected duplicate burns the whole cluster's stake. Honest agents, like a willow that bends without breaking, keep one identity through many seasons and grow cheaper trust over time, while cheap clones stay expensive to spawn.
